_comment: Metric workspace for OpenArm Pringles hand-over in the robot base frame (URDF `world` == IsaacLab env frame; checked: FK of the right TCP matches the sim can position at grasp to a few mm). Bounds = the sim RECORDING spawn box and its keep-out boxes, from IsaacLab openarm_task_modes.py (_RECORD_SPAWN_X/Y_RANGE, _HAND_KEEP_OUT_BOXES_AT_HOME with _CAN_GROWTH = max(0, 0.8*0.036625-0.030) = 0). Target = the truncated Gaussian the same env samples (_RECORD_SPAWN_GAUSSIAN), i.e. the randomized sim evaluation distribution if evaluation ran through lerobot_sim_server.py. These are sim spawn limits, not measured real-robot reachability.
name: sim_spawn_metric
